_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); premium revenue, medical care ratio, fee revenue, operating cost ratio and operating margin signals with UnitedHealth Group's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'UnitedHealth Group is a health care and well-being company with a mission to help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone.' 'If we fail to estimate, price for and manage our medical costs or design benefits in an effective manner, the profitability of our risk-based products and services could decline and could materially and adversely affect our results of operations, financial position and cash flows.' 'Premium revenues from risk-based products constitute nearly 80% of our total consolidated revenues.'; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a health benefits company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance', GENAI to 'generative / autonomous AI substitutes the core product: software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content, mobility', GLP1 to 'GLP-1 obesity drugs reduce demand for snacks, beverages, sleep-apnea/diabetes/cardio devices': none names health benefits, and no 10-K names offshore delivery; the FY24 10-K does not name cloud (the FY2015 to FY2019 10-K filings named it only among the solutions OptumInsight offers care providers, not as a substitute for UnitedHealth Group's business); it names generative AI only for UnitedHealth Group's own systems ('We anticipate that fast-evolving AI/ML technologies, including generative AI, will play an increasingly important role in our information systems and customer-facing technology products.'), not as a substitute for its business), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -35.0%/yr (worst year FY15-FY24, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +13.5%/yr (FY25 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +13.5%/yr (FY15-FY24 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +33.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY15-FY24, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNH (retrospective, 2025-04-11) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 1.75x (66.4% downside to Bear $201.60 / +37.9% upside to Bull $826.71) | Adj composite 2.19 vs market 2.50: gap -0.31 [MODESTLY OVERVALUED] | +24% above the EPP floor $482.80 (17x FY25E $28.40) | Conservative 2-yr case: +20.7% total (+10.3%/yr) | At 21.1x FY25E the 15% hurdle price $792.80 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; revenue +6.8% YoY in Q4 2024, forward revenues +12.4-13.7% (FY25 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
